note: Michigan U.S. Senate and governor races, researched Oct. 25, 2026.

candidates.name: Abdul El-Sayed
candidates.bio: Physician and epidemiologist who ran Detroit's health department and ran for governor in 2018.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would write Roe-era abortion rights into federal law and backs the Women's Health Protection Act (S. 2150)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would sponsor the Women's Health Protection Act, which limits state abortion restrictions
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed on energy
source.quote: fight for a pathway to 100% renewable energy

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed backs U.S. engagement in the Paris climate agreement
source.quote: The climate crisis is not a future threat. It's here.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed opposes U.S. dependence on oil and gas and would shut down the Line 5 pipeline
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would shut down Line 5 to protect the Great Lakes
source.quote: fight to hold corporate polluters fully accountable

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed now backs funding for police recruitment, retention and retirement; in 2020 and 2021 he called for reducing police budgets (CNN, July 2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed opposes cash bail
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed supports investing in community violence-prevention programs
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed supports the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would enforce antitrust law and break up corporate monopolies
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would invest heavily in new housing construction
source.quote: invest in building new housing

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would streamline local housing regulations
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed opposes vouchers and in 2018 proposed outlawing for-profit charter schools
source.quote: public money into private pockets

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would raise the minimum teacher salary to at least $60,000 a year
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would pass Medicare for All and abolish medical debt
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would pass Medicare for All and immediately repeal the 2025 Medicaid cuts
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed supports Medicare for All and breaking up big health care companies
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would immediately repeal the 2025 cuts to Medicaid and ACA subsidies
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed supports the DREAM Act (S. 3348)
source.quote: I believe in a safe and secure border and a clear pathway to citizenship.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed on refugees
source.quote: We must fully fund asylum and refugee programs.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would abolish ICE and restructure immigration enforcement
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed calls the Iran war illegal and unjustifiable and wants an immediate end to hostilities
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed opposes a nuclear-armed Iran but seeks diplomatic means to prevent one
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would pass the PRO Act (S. 852) and says right-to-work laws should be illegal
source.quote: every worker deserves the right to join a union

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would guarantee civil rights in health care for LGBTQ people
source.quote: I stand with the LGBTQ+ community in their struggle for equal rights and dignity.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed opposed ending the 988 crisis line's service for LGBTQ+ youth (2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed says wages must rise; in 2018 he proposed a $15 state minimum wage
source.quote: We need to stand up to increase wages.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would raise the top rate on income over $1 million and tax wealth over $1 billion
source.quote: It is high past time for us to tax billionaires their wealth.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed would raise the marginal tax rate on income over $1 million
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed opposes voter ID and the SAVE Act's proof-of-citizenship requirement
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: El-Sayed supports no-reason absentee and early in-person voting and an Election Day holiday
source.quote: I believe in making voting easier.

candidates.name: Mike Rogers
candidates.bio: U.S. representative from 2001 to 2015, former chair of the House Intelligence Committee and a former FBI agent; the 2024 Republican Senate nominee.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers supported overturning Roe v. Wade
source.quote: I'm a pro-life guy, I've voted pro-life.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers opposes a national abortion ban and says states should decide
source.quote: I will 100% respect Michiganders' decision on the abortion issue.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers says renewable energy mandates are expensive
source.quote: costing us all pretty dearly

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers would give law enforcement the resources they need
source.quote: back the blue all the way

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers on federal spending
source.quote: We can stop the spending in Washington that drove up prices.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers blames excessive regulation for high housing prices and would give home builders tax credits
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers wants Michigan to opt into the federal private school scholarship tax credit and voted for D.C. vouchers (House roll call 204, 2011)
source.quote: We have to have choice for our kids.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers backs a Great Lakes drilling ban and removing Line 5 from under Lake Michigan, but voted in 2014 to limit EPA Clean Water Act enforcement (House roll call 489)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers would create a health plan based on the free market
source.quote: embrace the freedom of the free market

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers says federally funded insurance plans don't work very well and voted against the Affordable Care Act (2010) and to repeal it (2013), though he opposed cutting health care to pay for defense (2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers would finish the border wall and reinstate the Remain in Mexico policy
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers favors tracking down criminals over mass deportations
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers would let the president continue the Iran war
source.quote: Iran is an imminent threat to our country

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers backed the 2023 UAW strike but voted to limit prevailing wages (2014) and NLRB action (2013)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers says people should not be evicted or fired for being LGBTQ
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers opposes transgender athletes in women's sports
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers voted against raising the federal minimum wage to $7.25 (House roll call 18, 2007)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers supports the 2025 tax cut law
source.quote: There's no tax cut I don't like.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers supports voter ID and the SAVE Act
source.quote: easier to vote and harder to cheat

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate voters guide: Rogers worries that more ways to vote, such as mail ballots, make votes harder to verify
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson supported Proposal 3, which put reproductive freedom in the Michigan Constitution
source.quote: fight to make sure women can make their own decisions

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson says overturning Roe v. Wade led to draconian bans
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson supported moving Michigan to 100% clean electricity by 2040 and the federal clean energy tax credits
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson on climate solutions
source.quote: both an imperative and an economic opportunity

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson would raise penalties for corporations that pollute Michigan's water, land and air and set enforceable Great Lakes guardrails
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson on health care
source.quote: should be a right, not a privilege

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson would push to restore the federal health care cuts
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson would expand low- or no-cost preventive care
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson supports protecting collective bargaining and unemployment benefits during strikes
source.quote: I'll always defend your right to organize.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson supported adding sexual orientation and gender identity to Michigan's civil rights law
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson opposed the effort to overturn the Supreme Court's same-sex marriage ruling
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson made it easier for transgender people to change the sex marker on state IDs (2019)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson proposes down-payment tax credits for first-time homebuyers
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson supports a state Voting Rights Act
source.quote: fight for your freedom to vote

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: Benson opposed state and federal proof-of-citizenship requirements for voter registration
source.quote: would be taking a chainsaw to our election system

candidates.name: John James
candidates.bio: U.S. representative for Michigan's 10th District since 2023, an Army veteran and businessman.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James on abortion (2018); in 2024 he said Michigan voters had already decided the issue with Proposal 3
source.quote: I am 100% pro-life.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James voted for H.R. 21 (2025), penalizing providers who don't care for infants surviving an attempted abortion; he has shifted on rape and incest exceptions
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James called Michigan's 100% clean electricity law insane and voted to end the clean energy tax credits (2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James supports cutting emissions
source.quote: through innovation rather than mandates

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James introduced a resolution to overturn the EPA's stricter vehicle emission rules (H.J.Res. 136) and voted to narrow the Clean Water Act, though he won funding for Lake St. Clair's sewer system
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James would ensure every officer has training, equipment, legal protections and respect
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James would ensure every officer has training, equipment, legal protections and respect
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James would keep violent criminals in prison
source.quote: lock up violent criminals

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James would opt Michigan into the federal private school scholarship tax credit on his first day
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James calls for market-based health care reforms
source.quote: The path to fixing healthcare is not more government, it's less.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James voted against extending ACA premium subsidies for three years (House roll call 11, 2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James voted for the 2023 border wall bill (H.R. 2)
source.quote: we need to lock our borders to protect us from drugs and terrorists

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James voted for $75 billion more for ICE and $70 billion more for DHS
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James voted for H.R. 2 (2023), which requires E-Verify for new hires

guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James supports right-to-work laws and voted against restoring federal workers' bargaining rights, though he has backed UAW workers and joined a nurses' picket line
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James voted to make providing gender-affirming care to minors a federal crime (H.R. 3492)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James voted to bar transgender students from girls' and women's sports (H.R. 28, 2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James said in 2018 that employers shouldn't be able to fire someone for being gay
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James would eliminate the state income tax
guides.vote, 2026 Michigan governor voters guide: James supports a constitutional amendment requiring voter ID at the polls and proof of citizenship to register
